translation_notes: Executable: the extract is a module-level statement with free names (g, CIM, dyn_models, uuids, model_types_used). context_shim.py binds them: dyn_models is the REAL detailed_model_types.json read from the pinned emthub clone (corpus/repos/temcdrm__emthub, what load_detailed_model_types() returns), g an empty graph, uuids {}, model_types_used a set of four DYR models (GENCLS, WTARA1, EXST1, REGCA1). The only edit to original.py is the added `from context_shim import ...` line (same in translated.ldpy). CIM_NS stays defined in the region, as in the extract.

The 14 g.add calls become two +{ } under `@graph g`: the seven triples on `mtyp` (shared subject, one ';' block) and the seven on `desc` in the inner loop. `for @bindings in` does not apply: both loops carry statements (uuids[...] = ID mutations, ID reassigned and reused as an interpolated value, a model_type lookup) around the writes; as in add_ibr_plant, a generator of dicts would restructure the code.

Literal(x, datatype=CIM.T) becomes `{x}^^cim:T` (same conversion as rdflib for str, float and '' - the typicalValue column mixes all three - and for the int sequenceNumber, whose lexical form is checked by the isomorphism). URIRef(ID) becomes f<{ID}> (no @base). The five EMT_NS/CIM_NS + 'X' IRIs per block become emt:X / cim:X; the three computed `EMT_NS + 'NthAmModelKind.{:s}'.format(...)` stay as `emt:{'...'.format(...)}` (computed local part), a call that remains Python.
